title: Man Faints After Realizing He Accidentally Killed His Wife

beats.description: Dramatic opening: Matthew and Kimberly in car, seconds from confrontation, foreshadowing tragedy
Police arrive at scene, multiple shooters, two critically injured victims, Matthew unaware wife is dead
Background on Matthew and Kimberly: wealthy business owners, 8,000 sq ft mansion, three children, hidden dark secret
Police search mansion, find drugs and signs of struggle in basement, evidence of volatile relationship
Flashback to 15 hours earlier: argument about Kimberly's affair, Matthew discovers $60,000 transferred to lover
Couple leaves mansion armed, arrives at lover's home where family is having barbecue, tension builds
911 call, shootout erupts, officers arrive to active shooter scene, Kimberly shot in neck, Matthew begging for help
SWAT clears house, find wounded homeowner Daniel, realize no active shooter, Kimberly pronounced dead
Police discover hidden marijuana grow and missing CCTV cameras in basement, key evidence for case
Detective Frasier takes over case, identifies key players: Matthew, Daniel, and family members
Interviews begin with Daniel's fiance Elona, who reveals affair but claims it ended years ago
Interview with Daniel's sister Gabriella confirms ongoing affair, Matthew as aggressor, family traumatized
Daniel interrogated from hospital bed, claims self-defense, refuses phone access, learns Kimberly is dead
Sponsor segment: Morgan and Morgan law firm advertisement
Search of Matthew's home finds drugs, guns, evidence of struggle; Matthew unaware of wife's death
Matthew learns Kimberly is dead, collapses in grief, then shifts to blaming Daniel and self-recrimination
Matthew gives his version of events, claims self-defense and concealed weapon; CCTV footage arrives
CCTV footage reviewed: shows Matthew as aggressor, Daniel's warning shot, fatal bullet from Daniel's gun
Detective confronts Matthew with inconsistencies, Matthew insists cameras will prove him right
Legal decision: Matthew charged with attempted murder and manslaughter, Daniel released under self-defense law
Trial and sentencing: Matthew found guilty, sentenced to 40 years; Daniel walks free; pattern of abuse revealed
